description: Pay an external x402 payment link (any https URL that returns an HTTP 402 USDC challenge) from the linked user's Swop wallet, within their caps. TWO-STEP like swop_send: call WITHOUT confirm to preview (amount, payee, host, caps), show it to the user and get their explicit yes, then call again with the returned previewId and confirm: true. Over-cap or no delegation returns a Swop-app approval link. Base USDC only.

confirm.description: true ONLY after the user confirmed the preview

name: swop_pay_x402_link
title: Pay an x402 payment link
